Houston Police Department General Orders (index).

§ 400-12 Surveillance Equipment.
This General Order establishes the policy for department surveillance equipment.

§ 400-28 Body Worn Cameras.
This General Order establishes the policy for body worn cameras.

§ 400-29 Automated License Plate Recognition.
This General Order establishes the policy for the automated license plate recognition program.
